correctness.rationale: The trihomogeneous (2,2,2) W has eight ordinary double points (origin, four sign triples, three infinity permutations) and crepant K3 resolution. Exact polynomial relation (1+y²z²)F=[(1+y²z²)x−2yz]²+SS′ identifies formal local node w²=st; adjoining √s and normalizing gives a smooth local surface with -I involution and one fixed point. Elsewhere local discriminant square classes define an étale double cover; connectedness follows from nonsquare restriction. Euler and Noether yield K3. Fiberwise over P¹_y×P¹_z the cover/base point difference equals χ(S)+χ(S′). The discriminant D(z)=z⁴−6z²+1 has exactly four repeated-root z-values and each contributes qχ_q(1+i); sum both factors to get 8εq. Repeat over every q^n, apply zeta logarithm and Lefschetz fixed-point dimensions (invariant 14, anti 8) to identify scalar Frobenius and orbit-set imbalance. Independent homogeneous enumeration over F_17 and F_41 gave W/X/U=(496,360,184),(2128,2456,1232), nodes=8, equal exact difference. Finite checks are corroboration, not proof of all extensions.
